nodes.text: explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): Review gatherer: paginate both store endpoints with perPage=100 and increasing page until a short or empty page, omitting review status and preserving observed statuses. Join strictly on Product_ID; for every product with at least one review compute the literal Review_Count and the average rating (full precision, 2-decimal display), keeping the full product name and the first category. Select the lowest five by average rating ascending, review count descending, then stable Product_ID. Return only the complete reviewed-products table (id, full name, avg_rating, review_count, first category), the frozen five-row ranking with complete product names, record counts, duplicate IDs, and page controls — no writes, no full item arrays.

coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): Workbook writer — sole writer of Product_Review_Analysis.xlsx. Create it exactly once with exactly two sheets: Review Summary with columns Product_Name (truncated to sixty characters), Avg_Rating (two decimals), Review_Count, Category (first category), one row per reviewed product sorted by Avg_Rating ascending; Stats with columns Metric, Value and rows Total_Products_Reviewed, Lowest_Rated_Product (truncated to forty characters), Avg_Rating_Overall (two decimals). Write all numeric values as literal numbers, never formulas; read both populated ranges back and return path, sheet order, row counts and equality controls.

coder 1 (external-workflow-operator 0): External writer — sole owner of form, event and email. Forms has no list/search: call create_form exactly once titled Product Quality Improvement Survey with the stated description, never retry an ambiguous failure, then append sequentially on that one formId five add_multiple_choice_question calls in frozen rank order, each using the product name in the question text with options ["1","2","3","4","5"] and required=true, followed by one add_text_question(..., required=false) for additional suggestions; call get_form and verify title/description/question order/types/options/flags. Filter list_events(timeMin="2026-03-20T00:00:00", timeMax="2026-03-21T00:00:00", maxResults=100, orderBy="startTime") locally for the exact Product Quality Review Meeting at 14:00-15:00; create it once only if missing with exact start.dateTime/end.dateTime, retain the ID, and call get_event. Paginate Sent search for product.team@company.com and exact subject Product Quality Alert - Review Required, send at most once naming the frozen five products, then read it back.
